concerns.text: Step 3 claims `unified_dataset.csv` conforms to `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml`, but the schema requires spatial‑metric fields (e.g., `correlation_length_exp`, `low_freq_spectral_power`, etc.) that the plan’s description of the download step does not produce. This mismatch will cause schema validation to fail.

FR‑011 (composite spatial ordering metric) is defined in the data model and specification, yet the plan never mentions computing or storing this composite metric. Without an explicit step, the requirement is unimplemented.
